_comment: Recorded model turns for `briefkasten demo handyvertrag`: routing to the contract specialist and a cancel-by deadline counted back from the end of the minimum term.

supervisor.text: I'll start by classifying the document.
A mobile phone contract. Explanation, extraction (for the cancel-by date) and the contract analysis are independent, so all three run now.
Next: the cancel-by date from the notice period, and a review of the explanation.
All required work for a contract is done.

input.notes: Summarised your phone contract, flagged the paid data top-ups and the price-increase clause, and worked out the cancel-by date: the notice must arrive by Sun 31.01.2027, so send it in good time.

input.reasoning: A contract summary for a mobile phone tariff with term, price and cancellation terms.

input.summary_en: This is the summary of your mobile phone contract with FunkNetz. You pay 34.99 € a month for unlimited calls and texts and 40 GB of data. The contract runs for 24 months until 28.02.2027; after that it continues month to month unless you cancel.
key_points: 34.99 € per month, plus a one-off 39.99 € connection fee.
Minimum term 24 months, ending 28.02.2027; one month's notice.
After the minimum term it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled any time with one month's notice.
Extra data is booked automatically (up to 3 × 2.99 € a month) unless you switch it off in the app.
input.if_ignored: If you do not cancel in time, the contract simply continues at 34.99 € per month, but you can then cancel it monthly.

glossary.english: special right to cancel (e.g. after a price increase)

deadlines.purpose: Cancel before the minimum term ends on 28.02.2027, if you don't want it to continue
deadlines.quote: Der Vertrag kann mit einer Frist von einem Monat zum Ende der Mindestvertragslaufzeit gekündigt werden.

amounts.quote: Monatlicher Grundpreis: 34,99 € in den Monaten 1 bis 24.

actions.description: Switch off the automatic data top-up in the app if you don't want to pay for extra data.
actions.quote: Die Datenautomatik kann jederzeit kostenlos in der App abbestellt werden.

input.renewal: Continues indefinitely after 28.02.2027 if not cancelled, then cancellable any time with one month's notice.
input.notice_period: One month before the end of the minimum term; afterwards one month at any time.
recurring_costs: up to 3 × 2,99 € per month for automatic data top-ups

key_terms.title: Minimum term
key_terms.explanation_en: You are bound for 24 months, until 28.02.2027.
key_terms.quote: Die Mindestvertragslaufzeit beträgt 24 Monate und endet am 28.02.2027.

key_terms.title: Notice period
key_terms.explanation_en: Cancel with one month's notice to the end of the minimum term.
key_terms.quote: Der Vertrag kann mit einer Frist von einem Monat zum Ende der Mindestvertragslaufzeit gekündigt werden.

watch_out.title: Automatic data top-ups
watch_out.explanation_en: When your data runs out, up to 3 GB are added automatically at 2.99 € each, up to 8.97 € extra per month. You can switch this off for free.
watch_out.quote: Nach Verbrauch des Datenvolumens werden bis zu dreimal pro Monat automatisch je 1 GB für je 2,99 € nachgebucht.

watch_out.title: Price increases
watch_out.explanation_en: FunkNetz may raise prices with six weeks' notice; you may then cancel early.
watch_out.quote: FunkNetz ist berechtigt, die Preise bei gestiegenen Kosten mit einer Ankündigungsfrist von sechs Wochen anzupassen.
